meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数字、标题或品牌标志做成几秒钟的动态短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想用短短几秒的动效把数字、标题或品牌讲清楚
copy.tagline_en: Turn a stat, headline, or logo into a few seconds of animated motion.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a few-second animated clip to make a number or brand land.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会自主做一支无旁白、以动效本身为信息的短片头(如动态字体、数字滚动、图表、logo 揭示等),产出 MP4 或透明叠加层,通常 10 秒内;渲染前会先问你。
howto.when: 当你要做无旁白的短片头动效,或要把地图、推文、网页界面做成动画时接管;更长、有旁白或多场景的走 /general-video,不确定则走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这个标题做成动态字体动画,10 秒以内
用这组数据做一个滚动到 1 万的数字动画
把这条推文做成动态卡片
say.note: 先检索再动画,无检索源则降级为无素材

howto.what_en: Claude autonomously builds a short, unnarrated motion graphic (kinetic type, count-ups, charts, logo reveals, etc.), rendering MP4 or a transparent overlay, usually under 10s. It confirms before rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a short, unnarrated motion graphic, or an animated map, tweet, or webpage/UI. Longer, narrated, or multi-scene work goes to /general-video; unclear cases to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make this title a kinetic-type animation, under 10 seconds
Animate this data as a count-up to 10,000
Turn this tweet into an animated card
